vars.message: What are the weekday building hours?
vars.context: The building is open from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM on weekdays.

vars.message: When does the building open on Saturday?
vars.context: Saturday opening hours are 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

vars.message: Is the building open on Sunday?
vars.context: The building is closed on Sundays and public holidays.

vars.message: Where is the facilities help desk?
vars.context: The facilities help desk is beside the main reception on level one.

vars.message: Where should I collect lost property?
vars.context: Lost property is held at the security counter in the main lobby.

vars.message: When does the air conditioning operate?
vars.context: Central air conditioning operates from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM on weekdays.

vars.message: How do I request cooling after hours?
vars.context: After-hours cooling requests must be submitted to the facilities help desk one business day ahead.

vars.message: How do I contact building security?
vars.context: Building security can be reached at extension 7000 at any time.

vars.message: Where is the evacuation assembly point?
vars.context: The evacuation assembly point is the open plaza north of Block A.

vars.message: How should visitors register?
vars.context: Visitors must register at reception and wear a visitor badge while in the building.

vars.message: What is the after-hours access policy?
vars.context: After-hours access requires an activated staff card and prior manager approval.

vars.message: Where can I park a bicycle?
vars.context: Bicycle racks are located beside the west gate and basement entrance.

vars.message: Are shower facilities available?
vars.context: Shower facilities are available beside the basement bicycle parking area.

vars.message: How do I book a meeting room?
vars.context: Meeting rooms must be reserved through the campus room booking portal.

vars.message: How do I cancel a room booking?
vars.context: Room bookings can be cancelled from the My Reservations page in the booking portal.

vars.message: Where should recyclable waste go?
vars.context: Paper, plastic, and metal recyclables belong in the blue recycling stations.

vars.message: Can food be eaten in teaching rooms?
vars.context: Food is not permitted in teaching rooms, laboratories, or the library.

vars.message: Where is smoking permitted?
vars.context: Smoking is prohibited throughout the campus, including outdoor walkways.

vars.message: When can suppliers use the loading bay?
vars.context: Supplier deliveries at the loading bay are accepted from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM on weekdays.

vars.message: How are large deliveries arranged?
vars.context: Large deliveries require a loading bay reservation at least two business days in advance.
